# AI Usage

AI coding assistants were used as a supporting tool during development.

Prompts mainly took the form of focused implementation and design questions, including:

* "Should sensors be created separately, or created when the first measurement is submitted?"
* "Should sensor IDs be generated by the database?"
* "Should measurements be stored as separate metric/value/timestamp rows instead of fixed temperature and humidity
  columns?"
* "How should a query represent one sensor, multiple sensors, or all sensors?"
* "Can the same query support both temperature and humidity?"
* "Should MIN, MAX, SUM and AVERAGE be handled with separate strategies or a simpler conditional?"
* "Should averages and other statistics be calculated in Java or directly in PostgreSQL?"
* "If no date range is supplied, should a raw query return the latest reading per sensor and metric?"
* "How should 'latest data' work for a statistical query when a statistic needs a time period?"
* "Should an invalid sensor ID return 404 while an existing sensor with no data returns an empty result?"
* "What should happen if one sensor ID is missing from a request containing multiple sensors?"
* "Should duplicate sensor names return 409 Conflict instead of 500?"
* "Would Spring ProblemDetail be a good way to return structured API errors?"
* "Should repository integration tests use PostgreSQL Testcontainers instead of H2?"
* "Which missing tests are useful based on the coding challenge requirements?"
* "What end-to-end tests would prove one, multiple and all-sensor queries work?"
* "What tests would prove MIN, MAX, SUM and AVERAGE are calculated correctly?"
* "How should the exact example of average temperature and humidity for one sensor over a week be tested?"
* "Which SonarCloud coverage gaps are worth testing, and which would only increase coverage without adding value?"
* "Is the Swagger documentation clear, and how should the endpoints and error responses be organised?"
* "What documentation and diagrams would be useful without overengineering the submission?"
* "How should the Spring Boot application connect to PostgreSQL when deployed on Render?"

AI suggestions were reviewed and adapted before inclusion. The final implementation, tests and design decisions were
tested and understood before submission.
